claims.text: The top 10 nonsynonymous mutations were selected based on their frequency and potential deleterious effects on protein function.
The selection included mutations with high concurrence ratios, suggesting functional interactions among them.
The mutations were identified from the GESS database, which provided data on co-mutation and frequency in primary lineages.
